In the figure above, $∠BOA$ is a straight angle, $\overset{\to }{OD}$ and $\overset{\to }{OE}$ are the bisectors of $∠AOC$ and $∠BOC$, respectively. If $m∠DOC=4x$ and $m∠COE=5x$, find the value of $x.$
question.worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14237394/assets/77adc8fb9c00bd21579a8697f8b11c228e3864e657f2b991be4d09b4c6f5a96d.png)

Since $\overset{\to }{OD}$ is the bisector of $∠AOC$, we have 

$$
m∠AOD=m∠DOC=4x.
$$

Since $\overset{\to }{OE}$ is the bisector of $∠BOC$, we have 

$$
m∠EOB=m∠COE=5x.
$$

Now, by the angle addition postulate, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠AOD+m∠DOC+m∠EOB+m∠COE & ={180}^{∘} \\ 4x+4x+5x+5x & ={180}^{∘} \\ 18x & ={180}^{∘} \\ x & ={10}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$
